use_case: Detect Green Line C service disruption during Sunday evening service with high-impact service alerts and active vehicles.

incidents.note: Green Line C to Cleveland Circle: 3 high-impact service alerts, 6 vehicles, 6 trip updates detected. Alert-based disruption with rider advisory warranted.
Green Line C to Government Center: 3 high-impact service alerts, 5 vehicles, 5 trip updates. Opposite direction of same disruption.
